name: Scroll Reveal
description: Heading text that reveals word by word, character by character or line by line as it scrolls into view, with optional blur, rotation, highlight glow and several entrance effects.
contents: A single h2 heading whose text is split into words, characters or lines
Accessible aria-label carrying the full text when children are plain text
behavior: In scrub mode the reveal progress is tied to scroll position through GSAP ScrollTrigger
In enter mode the reveal plays once on a timed duration when the heading nears the viewport
Pieces stagger in with opacity, optional blur, vertical offset and an effect-specific motion
Heading starts slightly rotated and straightens to 0 while revealing
Optional highlight color glows across each piece as it appears
Can listen to a custom scroll container instead of the window
Skipped entirely when the user prefers reduced motion, showing the plain text
Line splitting is re-measured on resize through ResizeObserver
editableByProps: Split unit, entrance effect, scrub or one-shot mode, duration and stagger
Blur, starting opacity, rotation, vertical offset and scrub smoothing
Highlight glow color and scroll end positions
Heading and text classes, custom scroll container

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the font size or line height defaults
needsCodeEdit.where: The className of the inner span with textRef (text-[clamp(1.6rem,4vw,3rem)] leading-[1.5])

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the start position of the scroll trigger
needsCodeEdit.where: The start function in the scrollTrigger of the gsap.to(state) call and the startAt function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the share of the scroll used per piece reveal

fixed: Requires gsap with the ScrollTrigger plugin, registered at module load
Renders an h2 with my-5 margin, so it carries heading semantics
Children must be plain strings or numbers to be split, otherwise the nodes render unsplit and animate as one block
Needs enough page scroll room below the heading for scrub progress to complete
Line splitting is measured from word positions and needs the text to be laid out
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by disabling all animation
Text size is fixed by a clamp between 1.6rem and 3rem, fluid across screen sizes
Unknown effect values behave like fade

options.look: Pieces fade in from low opacity, with optional blur and offset
options.useWhen: Long manifesto or about paragraph that should read calmly as the visitor scrolls

options.look: Words slide up from behind a mask as they fade in
options.useWhen: Hero headline or section title that should feel crisp and editorial

options.look: Pieces rotate in on the X axis with a slight overshoot
options.useWhen: Short punchy statement between sections that needs a playful flourish

options.look: Pieces grow from small with a bouncy overshoot
options.useWhen: Stats callout or slogan where a lively pop-in fits a bold brand
